name: Pizza Toast
summary: Sandwich bread topped with pasta sauce and cheese and baked until crisp. Pizza for the price of a loaf.

ingredients.name: pasta sauce (about half a 680 mL jar)

instructions: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Lay the bread on two baking sheets.
Bake the bare bread 4 minutes so the bottom doesn't go soggy.
Spread about 2 tablespoons of sauce on each slice, right to the edges.
Cover with the cheese, then sprinkle with oregano and chili flakes.
Bake 6–8 minutes until the cheese is bubbling and the crust edges are brown. Three slices per person.

substitutions.substitute: gluten-free sandwich bread, or halved baked potatoes as the base
substitutions.costNote: Gluten-free bread runs about $6–$7 a loaf (estimate), bringing the total to roughly $12

glutenFree.notes: Sauce, cheese, and oregano are naturally gluten-free. Check the sauce label.

budgetNotes: The other half of the sauce jar keeps a week in the fridge. Use it for Cheesy Baked Pasta or Shakshuka.
Any cheese works. Use whichever block is cheapest this week and grate it yourself.
Add sliced onion, leftover sausage, or frozen spinach if you have them. None are required.

pricingMetadata.notes: Bread $2.48/~20-slice loaf (Great Value), $0.12/slice. Pasta sauce $1.97/680 mL (Great Value, Walmart regular, November 2026; estimate). Cheddar $1.43/100 g (site estimate). Oregano estimated.
